nodes.npcLine: 🛏️ Here is your bedroom! There is a blue bed and there are two lamps on your desk. Is that your alarm clock?
nodes.grammarCheck: There is / There are & Possessive Adjectives ('There is a... There are two...')

playerOptions.text: ⏰ Yes, that is my alarm clock! My desk is next to my bed.
🪑 This is my desk and that is your bookshelf.

nodes.npcLine: ⏰ Your bedroom looks great! There are books on the desk and my lamp is on the table. Let me know if you need anything else!
nodes.grammarCheck: Plural Placement & Possessives ('There are books... my lamp')

playerOptions.text: 🙏 Thank you, James! I am ready to explore the kitchen.
